feedback: Written before this candidate has raced, so it states no outcome for it. Evidence from earlier races: iteration 8 (wheel_radius 0.04 m) gave the best score so far, 51.13, with s-bend progress 0.158, slalom 0.1075 and max_error 0.0608 to 0.0684. Iteration 5 (wheel_radius 0.035 m) raised s-bend progress from 0.150 to 0.155 with max_error held. Iteration 6 (mass 0.5 kg) and iteration 7 (wheel_track 0.14 m) both lowered progress, so mass 0.6 kg and track 0.12 m stay fixed. Controller gain changes (iterations 0, 1, 4) left max_error almost unchanged, so the Integrator has kept the iteration 8 controller unchanged to isolate the speed step. Interpret the next race as follows. If progress rises above 0.158 on the s-bend and above 0.1075 on the slalom, with max_error at or below 0.069 on every track, speed is still helping; keep wheel_radius 0.044 m. If progress is flat, or max_error rises above 0.069 on any track, speed has reached its useful limit at this controller setting; return wheel_radius to 0.04 m, the iteration 8 best, and stop changing geometry. The Integrator will report the progress and max_error at which the robot leaves the track.
